source.transcription: Detail strings are copied from evidence/journey_002/*.visible.txt. The prototype showed camera denial and storage pressure in its Capture row and the missing asset in its Viewing row; here they map to the HSA cameraPermission, storage and assets facts. Strings the prototype did not show use the HSA defaults from unknownCapabilities() in src/home/preflight.ts. Property references are synthetic.
